svg.title: Electronics assembler — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as electronics assembler, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A fine soldering iron meets the edge of a circuit board with a central component and two contact pads. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
